title: Binance Adds Pyth Network (PYTH) on Earn, Convert & Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Pyth Network (PYTH)  has been added to  Binance Simple Earn  and  Binance Convert . In addition, Binance will add  PYTH  on  Binance Margin  and  Binance Auto-Invest  at  2024-02-02 14:00 (UTC)  and  2024-02-05 00:00 (UTC)  respectively.  Earn Users can now subscribe to  PYTH Flexible Products  on Binance Simple Earn. From  2024-02-05 at 00:00 (UTC) , users may purchase PYTH using any of the payment options supported on  Binance Auto-Invest . Convert Users can now trade PYTH against BTC, USDT and any other tokens supported by  Binance Convert  at  zero fees .  Margin Binance Margin will add  PYTH  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  PYTH/USDT  pair on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2024-02-02 14:00 (UTC) . Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates.
